note: 语料例句（Tatoeba 英中句对，CC BY 2.0 FR）

w_commodity.en: It's a waste to just have the central banks watching over commodity prices.
w_commodity.zh: 只让中央银行当物价的守护者，未免太可惜了。

w_voluntary.en: She can only go to the company to do voluntary work on Sundays.
w_voluntary.zh: 她星期天也只能去公司做义务劳动了。

w_transit.en: The electrical appliance must have been damaged in transit.
w_transit.zh: 这个电子仪器肯定在运输途中损坏了。

w_compensate.en: You must compensate him for the money he lost.
w_compensate.zh: 你需要赔偿他损失的钱。

w_clarify.en: The point we must clarify here is that the lines between amateur and professional in sport are beginning to disappear.
w_clarify.zh: 我们必须阐明这个观点，在运动项目上，业余选手和专业选手的界限开始消失了。

w_mature.en: He grew a beard to look more mature.
w_mature.zh: 他留了胡子，为了让自己看起来更成熟。

w_empirical.en: In its more extreme variants, cis ideology can include denial of the empirical reality of intersex and transgender people.
w_empirical.zh: 在更极端的变体中，顺性别意识形态可能包括否认阴阳人和跨性别者的现实经历。

w_correspond.en: Your words must correspond with your actions.

w_passive.en: Tzu-hsiang's way too honest. He's hopelessly passive in relationships.
w_passive.zh: 子翔那个人太老实了，谈恋爱都被动得要命。

w_thesis.en: I'll need at least three days to translate that thesis.
w_thesis.zh: 要翻译那篇论文，我最少需要三天时间。

w_bond.en: There is a strong bond of affection between them.
w_bond.zh: 他们之间有着很强的感情联系。

w_assess.en: The purpose of this interview is to assess whether or not you are suitable for the company.
w_assess.zh: 这次面试的意义是评断你适不适合这家公司。

w_journal.en: My dad keeps a journal every day.

w_percent.en: We have a five percent chance of success.
w_percent.zh: 我们有百分之五的成功几率。

w_radical.en: She has a very radical opinion about the problem.
w_radical.zh: 她对于这个问题有很激进的意见。

w_radical.en: What's radical today may be cliché tomorrow.
w_radical.zh: 今天的激进也许是明天的老生常谈。

w_institute.en: A new classroom building was built in our institute last year.
w_institute.zh: 去年我们学院建了一个新教学楼。

w_cooperate.en: We are working hard to cooperate more.
w_cooperate.zh: 我们正在努力扩展合作。

w_ignorance.en: Moral evil is the result of ignorance.
w_ignorance.zh: 道德上的恶乃是无知的后果。

w_imitate.en: A parrot can imitate the human voice.

w_clause.en: There's a grammatical mistake in that clause.
w_clause.zh: 这个句子有个语法错误。

w_adjacent.en: The living room is adjacent to the dining room.

w_coincide.en: Publication of the article was timed to coincide with the professor's birthday.
w_coincide.zh: 文章的发表被预定在教授生日那天。

w_complement.en: A complete intransitive verb takes neither complement nor object.
w_complement.zh: 一个完完全全的不及物动词既没有补语，又没有宾语。

w_intermediate.en: My level in English is intermediate.

w_conform.en: We must conform to the rules.

w_coherent.en: The two sentences are both coherent.

w_arbitrary.en: My mother prefers the arbitrary selection of the lottery machines over my lucky numbers.
w_arbitrary.zh: 我母亲宁愿选彩票机上的任意数字，也不选我的幸运数字。

w_compute.en: Can you compute the distance of the moon from the earth?
w_compute.zh: 你可以把地球和月亮之间的距离计算出来吗？

w_compute.en: Scientists can easily compute the distance between planets.
w_compute.zh: 科学家们可以很容易地计算出行星之间的距离。

w_unify.en: He tried to unify the various groups.
w_unify.zh: 他试著统一不同的团体。

w_finite.en: Love is not a finite resource.

w_short.en: Ah, we have run short of sugar.
In short, it was a great party.
w_short.zh: 总之它是个很棒的派对。

w_short.en: Time is short, we must act NOW.
w_short.zh: 时间不多，我们必须马上行动。

w_congress.zh: 大会审查第十四个五年规划。

w_fire.en: He set fire to his own house.
w_fire.zh: 他点著了他自己的房子。

w_fire.en: In case of fire, ring the bell.
A wooden building can easily catch fire.

w_bank.en: I've got to go to the bank.

w_foreign.en: He has a lot of foreign stamps.

w_sound.en: Not a sound was heard in the room.
w_sound.zh: 房间里静悄悄的，听不到一丝声音。

w_sound.en: Be quiet, please! Don't make a sound.
Some birds can break the sound barrier.

w_fine.en: They fine you in Singapore if you throw trash in the streets.
w_fine.zh: 在新加坡的街道上扔垃圾会被罚款。

w_fine.en: It is likely to be fine tomorrow.
When he feels fine, he goes for a walk.

w_common.en: She and I have nothing in common.

w_compare.en: Compare the two carefully, and you will see the difference.
w_compare.zh: 仔细的比较一下，就会发现两者之间的分别了。

w_compare.en: You definitely can't compare Marseilles and Lyons.
w_compare.zh: 你绝不可把马赛和里昂相比。

w_compare.en: Compare your sentence with the one on the blackboard.
w_compare.zh: 比较一下你写的句子和黑板上的句子。

w_cultural.en: The dragon is one of the cultural emblems of China.

w_attorney.en: It's totally without precedent for the suspect's attorney to be the true culprit.
w_attorney.zh: 这前所未闻, 犯罪嫌疑人的律师竟然是真正的罪魁祸首。

w_senior.en: He is my senior by two years.
Are you a senior high school student?

w_forest.en: The boy got lost in the forest.
w_forest.zh: 小男孩在森林中迷路了。

w_forest.en: This forest goes on for a while.

w_global.en: As global warming increases, sea levels get higher and higher.
w_global.zh: 海面随着全球变暖的加剧而越来越高。

w_client.en: The investor stole the capital of his client.
w_client.zh: 投资者把他客户的资金窃取了.

w_conversation.en: After school, I go to an English school to practice English conversation.
w_conversation.zh: 放学后，我到一所英语学校去练习英语会话。

w_beginning.en: He is beginning to lose his hair.

w_stick.en: The old man walked with a stick.
w_stick.zh: 这个老人拄著一根拐杖走路。

w_stick.en: My grandfather cannot walk without a stick.
w_stick.zh: 我的祖父要用拐杖才能走路。

w_stick.en: I forgot to stick a stamp on the envelope.
w_stick.zh: 我忘记在信封上贴邮票了。

w_communication.en: Gestures are very important in human communication.
w_communication.zh: 在人类的交流活动中，身体语言非常重要。

w_apartment.en: My apartment is on the fourth floor.

w_observe.en: The doctor continued to observe the patient's behavior.
w_observe.zh: 医生继续观察病人的一举一动。

w_observe.en: I observe a chimpanzee peel a banana and eat it.
w_observe.zh: 我观察到一只黑猩猩剥了一根香蕉并吃了它。

w_understanding.en: It's good for our understanding of other cultures.
w_understanding.zh: 它有利于我们理解其他文化。

w_identity.en: We know the identity of Tom's killer.
w_identity.zh: 我们知道汤姆的杀手是谁。

w_faith.en: You don't have enough faith in yourself.
w_faith.zh: 你对自己没有足够的信心。

w_fit.en: My new shoes don't fit very well.
w_fit.zh: 我的新鞋子并不是很合脚。

w_fit.en: This box is too big to fit in my bag.
w_fit.zh: 这个箱子太大了，我的包装不下。

w_fit.en: I think this coat should fit you.
w_fit.zh: 我认为这外套应该适合你。

w_associate.en: You'd better not associate with those men.
w_associate.zh: 你最好不要和那样的男人交往。

w_associate.en: No wonder we associate bats with dark places.
w_associate.zh: 难怪我们会把蝙蝠和黑暗的地方联想在一起了。

w_associate.en: You shouldn't associate with men like that.
w_associate.zh: 你最好不要和那样的男人交往。

w_religion.en: The Baha'i Faith is a very cool religion.
w_religion.zh: 巴哈伊信仰是个很棒的宗教。

w_coffee.en: She made coffee for all of us.
w_coffee.zh: 她为我们所有的人煮咖啡。

w_background.en: In the background of the picture is a castle.
w_background.zh: 图片的背景是一座城堡。

w_construction.en: A new school building is under construction.
w_construction.zh: 一座新的教学楼正在建设。

w_intelligence.en: His intelligence and experience enabled him to deal with the trouble.
w_intelligence.zh: 他的智慧和经验使他能处理这个麻烦。

w_location.en: A bookstore in that location wouldn't make enough money to survive.
w_location.zh: 那个地点的书店无法赚足够的钱生存下去。

w_combine.en: We may combine your personal information with other information.
w_combine.zh: 我们可能会将你的私人信息和其他信息结合在一起。

w_bus.en: It is cheaper to go by bus.

w_remind.en: In case I forget, please remind me.
w_remind.zh: 如果我忘记了请提醒我。

w_academic.en: Academic fraud is more common than you might think.
w_academic.zh: 学术造假比你想象的普遍。

w_negative.en: Let go of your negative outlook on life.
w_negative.zh: 请抛开你那些负面的人生观。

w_negative.en: Smiling is the best remedy for negative emotions.
w_negative.zh: 笑容是坏心情的最佳药方。

w_historical.en: This is a city of real historical value.
w_historical.zh: 这是一个具有历史价值的城市。

w_medicine.en: He's very influential in the world of medicine.
w_medicine.zh: 他在医学界有很大的影响力。

w_medicine.en: This medicine cured me of my cold.

w_grab.en: Anybody wanna grab something to eat with me?

w_classroom.en: There is no one in the classroom.

w_familiar.en: All of you are familiar with the truth of the story.
w_familiar.zh: 你们所有的人都熟悉这个故事的真相。

w_familiar.en: We are familiar with the name of the place.
w_familiar.zh: 我们觉得这地方很耳熟。

w_actor.en: He is not a singer, but an actor.
w_actor.zh: 他不是歌手，但是个演员。

w_birth.en: The baby weighed seven pounds at birth.

w_application.en: She made out the application for admission.

w_neck.en: The cat had a ribbon around its neck.
w_neck.zh: 小猫的脖子上系著一条丝带。

w_neck.en: The girl had a long scarf around her neck.
w_neck.zh: 女孩的脖子上围著一条长长的围巾。

w_neck.en: When he shouted, the veins in his neck stood out clearly.
w_neck.zh: 他大喊的时候，脖子上青筋暴起。

w_plastic.en: A plastic dish will melt on the stove.
w_plastic.zh: 塑料盘子在烤箱里会化的。

w_plastic.en: No thank you, I don't need a plastic bag.
w_plastic.zh: 不，谢谢。我不需要塑料袋。

w_map.en: There is a map on the desk.
w_map.zh: 办公桌上面有一张地图。

w_map.en: There is a map on the wall.

w_literature.en: He majored in literature at the university.

w_instruction.en: From reading good books we can derive pleasure, friendship, experience and instruction.
w_instruction.zh: 读书，可以获得乐趣、友谊、经验和指导。

w_reading.en: But he is bad at reading English.
w_reading.zh: 但是他不擅于阅读英文。

w_reading.en: Some people think of reading as a waste of time.
w_reading.zh: 有些人认为阅读简直浪费时间。

w_sugar.en: There is no sugar left in the pot.
Sami's soda has a lot of sugar in it.
w_sugar.zh: 萨米的苏打水中含有大量糖。

w_sugar.en: Don’t put too much sugar in the coffee.

w_explore.en: I want to explore the world. It’s my dream.
w_explore.zh: 我想要去探索世界。那是我的梦想。

w_scientific.en: There is no scientific basis for these claims.
w_scientific.zh: 这些主张没有科学的根据。

w_instrument.en: Do you play any instrument other than the piano?
w_instrument.zh: 除了钢琴以外，还会玩什么乐器吗？

w_bear.en: Benjamin shot a bear with a rifle.
w_bear.zh: 班杰明用步枪射了一只熊。

w_bear.en: I've got a toothache. I just can't bear this pain anymore.
w_bear.zh: 牙疼。我无法忍受这种疼痛。

w_bear.en: I couldn't bear to look at her.

w_pocket.en: The boy has an apple in his pocket.
w_pocket.zh: 这男孩的口袋里有个苹果。

w_pocket.en: He thrust some coins into my pocket.
w_pocket.zh: 他把数枚硬币强行塞进了我的口袋中。

w_pocket.en: He took something out of his pocket.
w_pocket.zh: 他从口袋中拿出了什么。

w_temperature.en: The temperature has fallen below zero this morning.
w_temperature.zh: 今天早上温度降到了零下。

w_consequence.en: It is of no consequence to me that he is coming.
w_consequence.zh: 他要来这件事对我而言无关紧要。

w_teaching.en: He has a lot of teaching experience.
w_teaching.zh: 他在教学上拥有丰富的经验。

w_empty.en: You should especially not drink on an empty stomach.
You can't fight on an empty stomach.
w_empty.zh: 饿着肚子是没法打仗的。

w_empty.en: When I opened the box, it was empty.
w_empty.zh: 我打开盒子的时候，它是空的。

w_acknowledge.en: Acknowledge your own faults before criticizing others.
w_acknowledge.zh: 要批评别人时，先想想自己是否完美无缺。

w_yellow.en: The door of the office is yellow.
In the United States, school buses are yellow.

w_conclusion.en: We spent three hours to come to this conclusion.
w_conclusion.zh: 做出这个结论花了我们三个小时。

w_regulation.en: From today on this regulation is history.
w_regulation.zh: 从今天开始，这项规定成为了历史。

w_comfortable.en: I am quite comfortable in this room.
w_comfortable.zh: 在这个房间里我很舒服。

w_comfortable.en: My room is comfortable, if it is a little small.
w_comfortable.zh: 我的房间很舒适, 即使它小了一点。

w_angry.en: There's no need to get so angry.

w_meal.en: What kind of meal did you eat?
We eat a meal three times a day.

w_hearing.en: The hearing acuity of dogs is superior by far to that of humans.
w_hearing.zh: 狗的听觉比人类灵敏不知多少倍。

w_traffic.en: Jimmy was hurt in a traffic accident.
w_traffic.zh: 吉米在一场交通事故中受伤了。

w_traffic.en: He was injured in a traffic accident.
w_traffic.zh: 他在交通意外中受了伤。

w_traffic.en: He got injured in a traffic accident.
w_traffic.zh: 他在一场交通意外中受了伤。

w_capture.en: We were never able to capture him.
To be honest, we came to capture you.
w_capture.zh: 老实说，我们是来抓你的。

w_chest.en: This chest has old clothes in it.
w_chest.zh: 这个柜子里有些旧衣物。

w_beauty.en: She will be a beauty when she grows up.
w_beauty.zh: 她长大后一定会是个美人。

w_content.en: Use your own words to retell the content of the lesson.
w_content.zh: 用自己的语言把课文内容复述。

w_content.en: He was never content with his success.
w_content.zh: 对他自己的成就他从不感到满意。

w_sick.en: If a sick person folds one thousand paper cranes, her wish will come true.
w_sick.zh: 如果一个病人折一千只纸鹤, 她的愿望就会成真。

w_sick.en: He has been sick for a week.
It looks as if he were sick.

w_sheet.en: You are as white as a sheet.
Bring me a sheet of paper, please.
Please give me a sheet of paper.

w_extent.en: I agree with you to some extent.
w_extent.zh: 我在一定程度上同意你的意见。

w_pilot.en: My dream is to become a pilot.
w_pilot.zh: 我的梦想是成为一名飞行员。

w_pilot.en: I want to be a pilot in the future.

w_ultimately.en: Her line of reasoning is attractive, but ultimately fallacious.
w_ultimately.zh: 她说理的主线引人注目，但从根本上是靠不住的。

w_meat.en: He cut the meat with a knife.

w_soil.en: Nothing seems to grow in this soil.
w_soil.zh: 这个土壤似乎长不出任何东西来。

w_soil.en: She renewed the soil in the flower pot.
It is still raining a lot today, and the soil is being broken up.
w_soil.zh: 今天下这么大的雨，土松着呢。

w_criterion.en: The criterion of the scientific status of a theory is its falsifiability, or refutability, or testability.
w_criterion.zh: 一个理论的科学地位的标准是它的可证伪性、可反驳性或可检验性。

w_branch.en: He held on firmly to the branch.
The waterways branch out across the plain.
w_branch.zh: 水道如树枝般越过了平原。

w_branch.en: A new branch will be opened in Chicago next month.
w_branch.zh: 新的分店下个月在芝加哥开始营业。

w_ancient.en: There were no chairs in ancient China.

w_silence.en: Jessie stared at Jordan in dead silence.
w_silence.zh: 杰西死寂般沉默地盯著乔丹看。

w_silence.en: She stared at a UFO in silence.
w_silence.zh: 她注视着一个不明飞行物，哑口无言。

w_motion.en: They showed the scene in slow motion.
w_motion.zh: 他们用慢动作把那一幕播了出来。

w_motion.en: They looked relieved only when it was in motion.
w_motion.zh: 当它运转了，他们才看起来放心了。

w_solve.en: Tell me how to solve the problem.
w_solve.zh: 告诉我如何解决这个问题。

w_solve.en: He was able to solve the problem.

w_landscape.en: Sun lights the landscape, pain illuminates the soul.
w_landscape.zh: 阳光照亮田野，痛苦点亮心灵。

w_landscape.en: The strawberry tree is a commonly used landscape plant in this area.
w_landscape.zh: 草莓树是该地区常见的景观植物。

w_typical.en: This politician is a typical champagne socialist.
w_typical.zh: 这个政客是典型的香槟社会主义者。

w_hall.en: Someone left their umbrella in the hall.
w_hall.zh: 有人把他们的雨伞落在走道里。

w_ocean.en: There is sand at the bottom of the ocean.

w_afford.en: This car was so cheap that he could afford it.
w_afford.zh: 这车便宜得让他能买得起。

w_smart.en: You seem like a very smart person.
w_smart.zh: 你看起来像一个聪明人。

w_smart.en: I'm not as smart as I thought I was.
w_smart.zh: 我没我想像的那么聪明。

w_smart.en: He's very smart, and he's handsome too.

w_bedroom.en: There is no one in your bedroom.
w_bedroom.zh: 你的卧室里一个人也没有。

w_rare.en: My name is very rare in our country.
w_rare.zh: 我的名字在我的国家蛮少见的。

w_rare.en: It's rare to find big yards in Japan.
w_rare.zh: 能在日本找到这样的大的院子实属罕见。

w_nurse.en: Her dream is to become a nurse.
w_nurse.zh: 她的梦想是成为一名护士。

w_nurse.en: She may be a nurse. I am not sure.
w_nurse.zh: 她可能是护士。我不太肯定。

w_nurse.en: That nurse is very kind and polite.
w_nurse.zh: 那个护士人很好，又有礼貌。

w_pleasure.en: Few things give us as much pleasure as music.
w_pleasure.zh: 很少有东西像音乐一样带给我们这么多的快乐。

w_pleasure.en: It was a pleasure to meet you.

w_requirement.en: So friendship is also a requirement for happiness.
w_requirement.zh: 所以，友情也是幸福的一个要素。

w_pour.en: Pour melted butter over the popcorn.
w_pour.zh: 将融化了的奶油倒入爆米花中。

w_reference.en: Pei-rong, can I take a look at your report for reference?
w_reference.zh: 佩蓉，你那份报告可以借我参考一下吗？

w_reference.en: I don't like Google Translate either, but I always use it for reference.
w_reference.zh: 我也不喜欢谷歌翻译，但是我经常会使用它作为参考。

w_tear.en: Open the envelope carefully so it doesn't tear.
w_tear.zh: 小心地打开信封，以免撕破。

w_tear.en: They will tear down the old building in two days.
w_tear.zh: 他们将在两天内拆除这栋旧的建筑物。

w_hero.en: In spite of the tyrant’s persecution, the hero valiantly carried on the struggle.
w_hero.zh: 尽管受到暴君的迫害，英雄还顽强地斗争。

w_stretch.en: You have to stretch your muscles after swimming in the pool.
w_stretch.zh: 在泳池游完泳后要拉伸肌肉。

w_vegetable.en: The tomato is a vegetable, not a fruit.
w_vegetable.zh: 番茄是蔬菜而不是水果。

w_vegetable.en: Strictly speaking, the tomato is not a vegetable. It's a fruit.
w_vegetable.zh: 严格来说，蕃茄不是蔬菜，是水果。

w_improvement.en: Actually, the present method has plenty of room for improvement.
w_improvement.zh: 其实现时的方法还有很大的改善空间。

w_beach.en: We went to the beach last week.

w_opening.en: In opening the door, I broke the lock.
w_opening.zh: 我开门的时候弄坏了锁。

w_opening.en: The opening ceremony of the Olympics has already begun.

w_oppose.en: The city government wants to set up special cycle lanes. However, a lot of drivers oppose the idea.

w_wrap.zh: 可以帮我包起来吗？我拿来送人的。

w_wrap.zh: 请把它包装得像一个圣诞礼物。

w_appeal.zh: 汤姆的主意我不太感兴趣，这个我们之间说说就好。

w_association.zh: 不可以强迫任何人加入某个协会。

w_telephone.zh: 如果这条消息很重要，那就打电话告诉他。

w_confidence.zh: 信心、毅力、勇气三者具备，则天下没有做不成的事。

w_debt.zh: 你只需要喊他还债就行。

w_master.zh: 你才是自己命运的主人。

w_master.zh: 狗不安地看着他的主人。

w_wing.zh: 飞机失去了一部分机翼。

w_industrial.zh: 在中国乡村和工业区，有的人还是很穷的。

w_industrial.zh: 我突然想到他可能是个商业间谍。

w_aim.zh: 我的目标是成为一个医生。

w_aim.zh: 愿要大、志要坚、气要柔、心要细。

w_aim.zh: 他的人生只有一个目标：赚钱。

w_route.zh: 他可能是从另一条路回到了家。

w_route.zh: 不管你选哪条路，你都能按时到那里。

w_essential.zh: 记忆是我们大脑的一种主要功能。

w_diet.zh: 蝙蝠的食物主要包括昆虫和水果。
